title: must와 have to (의무)
goal: must와 have to로 '~해야 해요'를 말하고, 두 표현의 느낌 차이와 과거형 had to를 쓸 수 있어요.

points.title: must = 꼭 ~해야 해요
points.body: must + 동사원형은 '꼭 ~해야 해요'라는 강한 의무예요. 주어가 뭐든 must 모양은 그대로예요. (She must go. O / She musts go. X)

points.title: have to = ~해야 해요
points.body: have to + 동사원형도 '~해야 해요'라는 뜻이에요. 주어가 he / she / it이면 has to를 써요. (He has to work.)

points.title: 느낌 차이
points.body: must는 말하는 사람이 스스로 '꼭 해야겠다'고 느낄 때나 규칙·표지판에 많이 써요. have to는 회사 규칙, 상황처럼 바깥 이유 때문에 해야 할 때 써요. 일상 대화에서는 have to를 더 자주 써요.

points.title: 과거는 had to
points.body: must에는 과거형이 없어요. '~해야 했어요'는 주어와 상관없이 had to + 동사원형으로 말해요. (I had to wait.)

points.title: 질문은 Do / Does로
points.body: have to로 물을 때는 Do I have to ~? / Does she have to ~?처럼 써요. 대답은 Yes, you do. / No, she doesn't.처럼 해요.

formula: I / You / We / They + have to + 동사원형
He / She / It + has to + 동사원형

mistakes.why: 주어가 he / she / it이면 have가 has로 바뀌어요. She has to ~로 쓰세요.

mistakes.wrong: You must to wear a helmet.
mistakes.why: have to와 헷갈려서 must 뒤에 to를 붙이기 쉬워요. must 뒤에는 바로 동사원형이에요.

mistakes.wrong: I must go to the bank yesterday.
mistakes.right: I had to go to the bank yesterday.
mistakes.why: must는 과거형이 없어요. 과거에 해야 했던 일은 had to로 말하세요.

examples.en: You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike in Australia.
examples.ko: 호주에서 자전거를 탈 때는 꼭 헬멧을 써야 해요.

examples.en: I have to work at the café this Saturday.
examples.ko: 이번 주 토요일에 카페에서 일해야 해요.

examples.en: She has to pay rent every two weeks.
I must call my mum tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤에 꼭 엄마한테 전화해야 해요.

examples.en: We had to wait 30 minutes for the tram.
Do I have to bring my passport?
He has to start at 6 a.m. on the farm.
examples.ko: 그는 농장에서 아침 6시에 일을 시작해야 해요.

examples.en: All staff must wash their hands.
examples.ko: 모든 직원은 반드시 손을 씻어야 합니다.

choices: has
have
must
does
quiz.why: 주어가 She이고 뒤에 to가 있으니 has to예요.

quiz.sentence: You must ___ your ID at the bar.
choices: show
shows
to show
showing
quiz.ko: 바에서는 꼭 신분증을 보여 줘야 해요.
quiz.why: must 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형이 와요.

quiz.sentence: I ___ to work late last night.
choices: had
have
has
must
quiz.why: last night은 과거라서 had to를 써요.

quiz.sentence: We ___ to clean the kitchen every Sunday.
choices: have
has
must
do
quiz.why: 주어가 We이고 뒤에 to가 있으니 have to예요.

quiz.sentence: ___ I have to wear a uniform?
choices: Do
Does
Am
Must
quiz.why: I have to의 질문은 Do I have to ~?예요.

quiz.answer: He has to get up early tomorrow.
choices: He has to get up early tomorrow.
He have to get up early tomorrow.
He has get up early tomorrow.
He must to get up early tomorrow.

quiz.answer: We had to take the bus yesterday.
choices: We had to take the bus yesterday.
We must take the bus yesterday.
We have to take the bus yesterday.
We had take the bus yesterday.
quiz.why: 과거에 해야 했던 일은 had to + 동사원형이에요.

quiz.answer: You must shower before you swim.
choices: You must shower before you swim.
You must showering before you swim.
You musts shower before you swim.
You must to shower before you swim.
quiz.why: must는 모양이 바뀌지 않고, 뒤에 동사원형이 와요.

quiz.answer: Does she have to work every day?
choices: Does she have to work every day?
Does she has to work every day?
Do she have to work every day?
Does she must work every day?
quiz.why: She의 질문은 Does she have to ~? Does가 있으면 has가 아니라 have예요.

quiz.answer: My housemate has to pay the bills.
choices: My housemate has to pay the bills.
My housemate have to pay the bills.
My housemate has pay the bills.
My housemate must pays the bills.
quiz.why: My housemate는 한 사람(he / she)이라 has to + 동사원형이에요.

quiz.answer: I had to work last weekend.
choices: I had to work last weekend.
I must work last weekend.
I have to work last weekend.
I had to worked last weekend.
quiz.why: 지난 주말은 과거라서 had to, 그리고 to 뒤는 동사원형이에요.

choices: Workers must wear safety boots.
Workers must to wear safety boots.
Workers must wearing safety boots.
Workers musts wear safety boots.
quiz.why: must + 동사원형. must에는 to도 -s도 붙지 않아요.
